trial_title: The Safety and Feasibility of Transoral Endoscopic Thyroidectomy Vestibular Approach
brief_summary: This is a single center, prospective case series designed to assess the safety and feasibility of TOETVA in a small cohort of patients at University Health Network Toronto. Included patients will undergo a TOETVA-procedure in stead of the standard open surgical procedure.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients needing surgery for: Benign or indeterminate nodule less than 6 cm in size or; T1 well differentiated papillary carcinoma less than 2 cm in size or; Well-controlled Grave's disease or; Parathyroid adenoma.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has metastatic papillary thyroid cancer, which does not meet the criteria for benign or indeterminate nodules.

eligibility_table.criterion: Total thyroid size is 7-8 cm (no more than 10 cm)
eligibility_table.justification: Total thyroid size is not provided; therefore, it cannot be determined if it is within the specified range.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the total thyroid size of the patient between 7 cm and 10 cm?

eligibility_table.criterion: Their age is ≥18 years and ≤80 years
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 75 years old, which is within the age range of ≥18 years and ≤80 years.
The patient's ability to give written consent is not specified.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Can the patient demonstrate an understanding of the risks and benefits of the transoral endoscopic thyroidectomy vestibular approach as assessed by a standardized consent comprehension questionnaire?

eligibility_table.criterion: History of neck surgery or neck radiotherapy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of neck surgery (neck mass resection) and neck radiotherapy (XRT), which disqualifies them.
The patient has metastatic papillary thyroid cancer, indicating recurrent thyroid disease.
The patient has lymph node metastases, which disqualifies them.
There is no information provided regarding the presence of intraoral infections.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any intraoral infections requiring treatment within 30 days post-transoral endoscopic thyroidectomy?

eligibility_table.criterion: Presence of extrathyroidal or substernal extensions
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a large tumor size and metastasis, indicating the presence of extrathyroidal extensions.
There is no information provided regarding the patient's smoking status.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a history of smoking ≥1 pack per day for at least 10 years?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient's weight is not provided, making it unclear if they meet the morbid obesity criteria.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a body mass index (BMI) ≥30 kg/m²?

eligibility_table.criterion: Contra-indication to general anesthesia with nasotracheal intubation
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's history does not specify any contraindications to general anesthesia, but the age and medical history raise concerns.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented history of severe respiratory compromise or obstructive sleep apnea that would contraindicate general anesthesia with nasotracheal intubation?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no mention of previous mediastinal surgery in the patient's history.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone any mediastinal surgical procedures in the past?

eligibility_table.criterion: Any anatomical anomaly that in the opinion of the investigator may render the intervention more difficult (ex. variations in the structure of the platysmas muscle)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's anatomical details are not provided, making it difficult to assess any potential anomalies.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any anatomical variations in the platysma muscle or surrounding structures that could complicate a transoral endoscopic thyroidectomy, as assessed by preoperative imaging?

eligibility_table.criterion: Any medical condition, which in the judgment of the investigator and/or designee makes the subject a poor candidate for the investigational procedure
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's multiple health issues and advanced age may complicate the procedure, but specific judgment is needed from the investigator.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a bleeding risk score of ≥3 based on their medical history and current conditions?
